# Example Files for Structure Relaxation using CHGNET-LAMMPS MD

* cif2data.py : Convert .cif files to LAMMPS .data format using OVITO - Open Visualization Tool Python
* USPEX_6.data : LAMMPS data file is generated by USPEX output .cif file
* USPEX_6.inp : LAMMPS input file for NPT calculation settings
* after_opt_USPEX_6.data : LAMMPS output .data file
* data2cif.py : LAMMPS .data file converter to .cif format
* batch_data_cif.sh : batch data file conversion script using data2cif.py
* USPEX_6.cif : Final structure after relaxation
